Description / Purpose: Type of secondary electron detector used. Everhart-Thornley (ET) detector is the standard off-axis collector sensitive to SE2 and some BSE; in-lens (TLD) detectors collect high-resolution SE1 signal at short working distances; GSED/ESED detectors operate in VP/ESEM mode by using the chamber gas as the signal amplification medium.
Example / Allowed Content: Everhart-Thornley (ET) | In-lens / TLD (through-the-lens) | GSED (VP/ESEM) | ESED (VP/ESEM) | Other: specify | N/A | None

Description / Purpose: Type of backscattered electron detector. Solid-state diode detectors (single or segmented) are standard; YAG scintillator detectors offer high sensitivity at low voltage. Segmented detectors can operate in composition mode (segments summed) or topography mode (differential signal between segments). In-lens BSE detectors provide improved BSE collection at short working distances.
Example / Allowed Content: Solid-state diode (single) | Solid-state diode (segmented, composition mode) | Solid-state diode (segmented, topography mode) | In-lens BSE | YAG scintillator | Other: specify | N/A | None

Description / Purpose: Physical size of each image pixel at the sample surface, in nm or µm. Defines spatial sampling of SE or BSE images. For large-area mosaic imaging, report the pixel size of individual tiles and the number and arrangement of tiles.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., '5 nm' | '50 nm' | '500 nm' | '2 µm (mosaic: 19x16 tiles)'
